events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic double album, officially titled 'The Beatles', was released in 1968, showcasing a diverse range of musical styles.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles delivered a masterpiece with the 'White Album'. A sprawling, experimental double LP that still sounds incredible.

events.title: Tribute to Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80
events.blurb: Legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away in 1991 at the age of 45, leaving behind an unparalleled musical legacy.

angles.name: Freddie's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury. Thirty-five years since we lost him, his voice and stage presence remain unmatched. He would have been 80 this year.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The groundbreaking Beatles album 'Rubber Soul' was released in 1965, marking a significant artistic progression for the band.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Milestone
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. An album that truly stretched the boundaries of pop music. Still sounds fresh today.

events.title: Tribute to John Lennon, who would have been 86
events.blurb: Iconic Beatles co-founder John Lennon was tragically killed in 1980 at the age of 40.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. He would have been 86.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The influential British singer-songwriter and actor David Bowie was born in 1947 and passed away in 2016.

angles.name: Celebrating The Starman
angles.copy: Remembering the legend, David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today. His impact on music, fashion, and culture is simply immeasurable.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, was born in 1935 and died in 1977.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: The King, Elvis Presley, would have been 92 today. His music defined an era and continues to captivate generations.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: English musician, songwriter, and record producer Jimmy Page, best known as the guitarist and founder of Led Zeppelin, was born in 1944.

angles.name: Guitar God's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! The Led Zeppelin mastermind behind some of rock's most iconic riffs.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart, the iconic British singer-songwriter known for his distinctive raspy voice, was born in 1945.

angles.name: Rod The Mod Turns 82
angles.copy: Raising a glass to Sir Rod Stewart on his 82nd birthday! A true rock and roll legend with a career spanning decades.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, known as Suggs, the charismatic lead singer of the English ska band Madness, was born in 1961.

angles.name: Madness Frontman's Day
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the one and only Suggs! The voice of Madness, bringing us classics and still owning the stage.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Paul Young, known for his blue-eyed soul hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', was born in 1956.

angles.name: Wherever I Lay My Hat...
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the smooth-voiced Paul Young! Still got that 'Love of the Common People' for him.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The iconic American country music singer-songwriter, actress, and businesswoman Dolly Parton was born in 1946.

angles.name: Dolly's Big Day
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the queen of country, Dolly Parton! An absolute legend whose talent and heart shine as brightly as her rhinestones.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: English singer, songwriter, and Take That frontman Gary Barlow was born in 1971.

angles.name: Gary B Turns 56
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! From boyband heartthrob to national treasure.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his 80s hits like 'Caribbean Queen', was born in 1950.

angles.name: Caribbean King's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the fantastic Billy Ocean! Get outta our dreams and into our cars with those timeless tunes today.

events.title: First Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony (1989)
events.blurb: The inaugural Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held in 1989, honouring pioneering figures in music.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago today, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its very first induction ceremony. Imagine being in that room!

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Mark Owen, a member of the pop group Take That, was born in 1972.

angles.name: Take That's Mark Owen
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Still charming audiences after all these years.

events.title: The Beatles' famous rooftop concert (1969)
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their final public performance, an unannounced rooftop concert on Savile Row, London, in 1969.

angles.name: Rooftop Rockers
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert. What a way to go out!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: English drummer, singer, and songwriter Phil Collins, known for his work with Genesis and a successful solo career, was born in 1951.

angles.name: Phil The Thrill Turns 76
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! From Genesis to solo stardom, his drum fills and vocals are undeniable.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: British actor Hugh Grant, known for his roles in romantic comedies and character-driven performances, was born in 1960.

angles.name: Hugh Grant's Charm
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 67th birthday to the ever-charming Hugh Grant! Always a delight on screen.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, actor, and record producer Justin Timberlake was born in 1981.

angles.name: JT's Big Day
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From 'N Sync to solo success, he's still bringing the moves and the hits.

events.title: The Day The Music Died (1959)
events.blurb: A plane crash in 1959 tragically took the lives of rock and roll stars Buddy Holly (who would have been 91), Ritchie Valens (who would have been 86), and The Big Bopper (who would have been 97).

angles.name: Remembering The Legends
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago, rock and roll lost three of its brightest stars on 'The Day The Music Died'. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Rick Astley, famous for his 1987 hit 'Never Gonna Give You Up', was born in 1966.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to the one and only Rick Astley! Still got us dancing after all these years.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Jamaican reggae icon Bob Marley was born in 1945 and passed away in 1981.

angles.name: One Love, One Legend
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Bob Marley on what would have been his 82nd birthday. His message of peace and unity lives on.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: American singer-songwriter and musician Carole King, renowned for her extensive contributions to popular music, was born in 1942.

angles.name: Tapestry of Talent
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King! A songwriting genius whose melodies have shaped generations.

events.title: Tribute to Whitney Houston, who would have been 64
events.blurb: The iconic American singer and actress Whitney Houston passed away in 2012 at the age of 48.

angles.name: Remembering The Voice
angles.copy: Fifteen years since we lost the incomparable Whitney Houston. Her powerful voice and incredible talent are truly missed. She would have been 64.

events.title: Anniversary of Take That's original split
events.blurb: Take That, one of Britain's biggest boy bands, originally announced their split in 1996, devastating fans worldwide.

angles.name: That Heartbreak Moment
angles.copy: Can you believe it's been 31 years since Take That first announced their split? A day etched in pop history!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: Alistair 'Ali' Campbell, the lead singer and co-founder of British reggae band UB40, was born in 1959.

angles.name: Red Red Wine & Reggae
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell of UB40! Still bringing those reggae vibes and classic hits.
